senses.gloss:
म्लै म्लै, cl. 1. P. म्लायति (ep. also A.
म्लायते, and cl. 2. P. म्लाति, म्लान्ति),
मम्लौ (मम्ले), म्लास्यति, अम्लासीत्, म्लायात् or
म्लेयात्, म्लातुम्, to wither, fade, decay; to be
faint or languid, grow weary, languish; to become
weak or feeble; to become thin or emaciated; to
be dispirited or downcast; to be sad: Caus. म्लाप-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to wither or fade; to enfeeble,
make languid or dispirited, emaciate; [cf. Gr. βλάπτω
= Caus. म्लापयति, μῶλυς, μωλυρύς.]
